title: PR previews stay deterministic
description: Use an isolated gateway with orchestration disabled, an empty assessment store, assessment enabled with provider unavailable-proof, and a saved rule. Set FARMSLOT_ASSESSMENT_VALIDATION=1, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and PR_PREVIEW_PROOF_PARAMS with rule id and an explicit readable PR target.

preview.intent: Use the real preview RPC, assert a collected PR with no model work, and compare review intents and rule state before/after.

resumption.intent: Start an owned isolated gateway with a local GitHub CLI fixture; prove timeout, checkpoint persistence across restart, cursor continuation, one pause error for many candidates, and real shared-child cancellation isolation. Set PR_PREVIEW_RESUME_OUT to a new directory and PR_PREVIEW_RESUME_PORT to a free port.
